rows: - The Chromium log the test now keeps shows the cause in `chromium.log`: `FATAL: components/services/font_data/font_data_service_impl.cc:379] Check failed: . : No space left on device (28)`. The renderer's font service died on the runner's small `/dev/shm` (the runner is a container; this sandbox has a 16 GB one, which is why nothing reproduced locally), so the page never answered and `page.goto` waited its 30 s. The harness's own launch (`harness-browser/src/browser_launch.rs`) already passes `--disable-dev-shm-usage`; the Chromium that `Attached::start` spawns itself in `wf-harness/tests/e2e/browser.rs` did not. It does now. One of the two journeys that failed in run 40267446218 passed here by luck of what else held shared memory; the other failed with this FATAL. The 30 s wait is unchanged.
